description: RAIN watches RPM, pharmacy, clinical, and SDOH feeds overnight and surfaces chronic disease deterioration before you ask: CHF/COPD decompensation trends, medication gaps, diabetes control loss, and the continuity breaks created by the Battle Mountain provider reassignment.

A single conversational interface reasoning across the RPM platform, pharmacy claims, clinical EHR, provider panels, and SDOH data at once — connecting a worsening RPM trend, a lapsed refill, a reassigned provider, and a transport barrier into one patient story no single system tells.

Forecasts 30-day hospitalization risk from RPM trends, medication gaps, and SDOH barriers, ranking the cohort into risk tiers and projecting how same-day pharmacy, transport, and telehealth outreach reduces avoidable admissions.

Generates the Tier 1 outreach package — pre-populated care summaries, pharmacy outreach, NEMT requests, telehealth visits with re-paneling, and a community health worker task — directly from the conversation, with the cross-system evidence chain assembled per patient.
